[EN] My stock is limited. Sneaking shipments past the archdevas, those cursed Parthians, and the guwangis isn't easy.

Still, let us trade.
[ES] Mi inventario es limitado. Introducir cargamentos de contrabando pasando a los archdevas, a esos malditos parthians y a los guwangis no es fácil.

Aun así, hagamos negocios.
